scientific limitations/integrity: The claim is restricted to 1<p<infinity. The sharp constant is taken from arXiv:2609.33159v1; the new claim is the complete equality classification and its spectral and index-rigidity consequences. Classical cosine-power Fourier coefficient identities are supporting algebra, not claimed independently as new. A highly relevant 2026 paper by Shi, Li and Lian was identifiable and its coefficient theorem was cross-checked through accessible descriptions and an open paper quoting it, but its complete primary text was not available through accessible open sources during review; this remains a literature risk. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Extremizer spectrum and index rigidity for sharp harmonic Hardy coefficients
